static_traits.name: 柯特妮
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可以交谈，但尚not yet向他们讨论自己的恐惧；其余Not disclosed
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往not yet有类似恐惧；not yet接受过心理治疗或心理咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作度较好；能描述trigger情境与身体反应；自述尝试用逻辑与安全措施来安慰自己但效果有限；Neutral attitude；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我对攀岩时会坠落并Death的恐惧显著影响了我享受攀岩的能力。恐惧在几个月前我的一位要好的朋友发生攀岩事故后开始，并一直加重；每当想到或计划去攀岩时都会出现强烈的恐惧与Anxiety，以致难以参与这项活动。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到对坠落并Death的恐惧正在阻止我享受热爱的攀岩，因此希望通过咨询来处理这个问题并重新享受攀岩。
growth_experiences: 几个月前，一位关系密切的朋友在攀岩中发生事故。这一事件使我开始强烈担心攀岩的安全性，压力水平显著升高。此后，每当看到岩壁、回忆那次事故或计划攀岩时，我都会出现强烈的恐惧与Anxiety，逐渐难以享受并参与攀岩。

core_beliefs: 攀岩高度危险，我很可能会失足坠落并Death
即便采取安全措施，也without法真正避免严重事故

special_situations.event: Gazing at the rock wall before climbing or being in a climbing setting
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我开始攀登，就很可能失足坠落并发生严重伤害甚至Death
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to focus on safety measures and rationalize risks, postpones or avoids climbing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time something will very likely go wrong; I will fall and die

special_situations.event: When planning a rock-climbing activity (checking routes, inviting companions, preparing equipment)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我去攀岩，not yet来必定会发生最坏情况
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 取消或弱化计划、not断在脑中预演危险场景以自我“提醒”并避免
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管怎么准备，最终都会发生可怕的事故

special_situations.event: 回忆朋友几个月前的攀岩事故
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they had an accident, I am also very likely to suffer similar serious consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以朋友的事故为证据Reinforcement自己对风险的判断、减少接触攀岩相关信息
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She had an accident; sooner or later the same thing will happen to me

special_situations.event: 思考安全措施但情绪仍然高涨
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I feel intense fear, it means the danger is indeed great
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles the use of rationality and safety checklists to suppress emotional reactions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am so scared; it must be because it really is dangerous

core_conflict.wish: 渴望在确Security guard全的前提下Freedom地进行自己热爱的攀岩，并被同伴接纳而not被视为软弱
core_conflict.fear: 害怕在追求攀岩的过程中遭遇not可控的危险而受伤或Death；同时害怕暴露脆弱后被朋友看作软弱而受到评判
defense_goal: 通过回避攀岩或推迟计划来降低危险与Anxiety
对外保持坚强not透露恐惧以避免被视为软弱
以Intellectualization方式强调安全细节来弱化情绪

object_relations.self_representation: A rock climber who needs to hide vulnerability, worried about being seen as weak
object_relations.object_representation: 朋友可能会评判或轻视我的脆弱

object_relations.self_representation: 在危险情境中易受伤的个体
object_relations.object_representation: 攀岩环境/岩壁是not可控且致命的危险客体

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether they are willing to share their fears and vulnerability with friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 如果我说出恐惧，朋友会认为我软弱并看not起我（移情：将内在的自我评判投向他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平静克制的语气简短回应，Displacement话题到中性内容，避免use情绪性词汇与细节暴露。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及攀岩风险或回忆朋友事故、Anxiety升高时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为只有用更多事实与规则才能保持掌控与安全（移情：将not安全感投向环境并用理性与规则对抗）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses expert-style, data-based language to list safety checklists and probabilities, tone restrained, avoiding the level of feelings, focusing on 'facts' and 'steps'.

manifestations: 朋友的攀岩事故引发对自身坠落Death的强烈担忧
每次计划或想到攀岩便出现关于Death的最坏情境想象
outcomes: Decreased enjoyment of life、其他活动也变得紧张

manifestations: 担心被视为软弱而not愿向朋友分享恐惧
Keeps silent on important issues and reduces help-seeking
outcomes: The support system has difficulty functioning

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 担心“看起来很软弱”，过度顾虑他人评价而not愿开口
Overly cautious when sharing emotions and seeking support

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: 把原本可以向朋友寻求支持的冲动收回，not向外表达恐惧
将能量用于自我Repression与内在消化而非外部求助

positive_force: 热爱攀岩，具备持续动机
有一定的朋友资源可对话（尽管not yetuse）
Willing to seek help and enter counseling，表现出改变动机
Can try using rationality and safety measures to manage fear
对治疗计划持希望态度，愿意记录trigger与身体反应
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的认知模式显著
因朋友事故产生的过度概括Reinforcement危险感
回避行为导致经验纠正机会减少
not愿暴露脆弱，限制了社会支持的获取
Anxiety泛化到其他活动，降低生活乐趣

target_behavior.behavior: 对攀岩的强烈恐惧与回避（伴随Anxiety、生理激活）
antecedent: 注视岩壁或置身攀岩场景
Plans a rock climbing activity (checks routes, prepares gear)
target_behavior.core_reason: 朋友攀岩事故后形成对坠落与Death的灾难化与“预测not yet来”认知，情绪化推理使恐惧维持并加重
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在危险与强烈Anxiety，维持主观的安全与控制感
target_behavior.consequence: without法参与和享受攀岩，Decreased enjoyment of life；紧张与过度思虑泛化到其他活动，影响日常生活
